taking care of yourself.description: Explore technology that could help people manage diabetes while maintaining independence and everyday routines.

scenarios.one:
Self care: A personal diabetes companion 
 A tool that helps you understand your health, manage everyday routines, and make choices that work for you. 
 Imagine having a personal companion that quietly helps you manage your diabetes
scenarios.two:
Safety: A responsive health support system 
 A system that notices when something might be wrong and helps connect you to appropriate support. 
 Imagine receiving timely support when you need it, without having to constantly ask someone else for help.
scenarios.three:
Community & connection: A family recipe companion 
 Helps adapt the meals you already cook together, so managing your health stays part of shared life. 
 Imagine cooking a family recipe together, with a quiet nudge toward a healthier way to make it just as delicious.

questions.initial: What do you like most about this option for supporting yourself with diabetes?
questions.context: How could this idea help you take care of yourself and manage diabetes in everyday life?
questions.final: If we decided to build this technology, what would you change or add to make it more useful and comfortable for people living with diabetes?

taking care of our elders.description: Explore technology that could help older adults remain independent, safe, connected, and engaged.

scenarios.Self care:
A simple reminder system 
 Your relative controls it themselves, nudging them about medication and appointments in their own words and language. 
 Imagine your father setting his own reminders, in his own words, and feeling proud he never has to ask for help.
scenarios.Safety:
A direct alert service 
 Notifies you if a dose or appointment is missed, wherever you are. 
 Imagine getting a gentle message the moment your mother misses her medicine, wherever you happen to be that day.
scenarios.Relatedness:
A shared family check-in space 
 Lets relatives near and far see how your elder is doing, without anyone feeling watched over. 
 Imagine your parent browsing nearby dance classes and game nights, and choosing to join in on their own terms.
